items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: I heard of Clarence, but I didn't, see we never did talk, because we used to go down to this place there on Tulane Avenue rehearsal.

ctx.x: Did you know who the big boy was in relation to me? Did you know that? No. Sure, Claymore was my uncle, man. Oh, Claymore was your uncle. Yeah. You know who else was in relation to me, and I didn't find out we was in there talking? You know, Clarence Williams? Yeah. Well, Clarence Williams, I used to go see Clarence. You know, Clarence Williams, I used to go see Clarence Williams, I used to go see Clarence Williams. So I said, man, I should have stayed around my uncle a little longer. I said, who's your uncle? I…
Your cousins, Clarence Williams? Clarence Williams, Clarence Williams, yeah. Stay with him. Have you heard anything about Clarence Williams lately? How his health is, and I know he had a stroke.
